texto: **얼마나 + adjetivo + -(으)ㄴ지 모르다** can emphasize a degree: **얼마나 좋은지 몰라요** = don't imagine how good it is. It doesn't always literally mean that someone doesn't know anything.

**-(으)ㄴ지** also introduces an indirect question with adjectives: **몰라요** means «I don't know.» and **모르겠어요**, depending on the context, «I don't know. I'm not sure.»; one does not always express more certainty than the other.
The context helps to distinguish an indirect question from the emphatic use of **얼마나**.
